unix-full-path-safe-test.reason: An equality full_path selection has no traversal and is semantically valid.

unix-pattern-directory-traversal-test.reason: The schema admits the shape, but a patterned directory selection cannot request traversal.

windows-pattern-directory-traversal-test.reason: The Windows patterned directory traversal combination is semantically rejected.

windows-literal-reserved-name-test.reason: A literal Windows filename cannot contain a reserved character; this is a semantic error, not a schema error.

windows-pattern-reserved-name-test.reason: Reserved characters in a match expression are allowed; the literal-name rule is not applied to regex syntax.

family-vocabulary-safe-test.reason: The literal family value unix is in the source vocabulary.

family-vocabulary-invalid-test.reason: An empty literal family is reserved for variable serialization and is semantically invalid.

interface-type-safe-test.reason: ARPHRD_ETHER is a source OVAL interface-type literal.

interface-type-invalid-test.reason: The empty interface type is not a native literal; it is reserved for variable serialization.

lockout-time-safe-test.reason: Zero is the inclusive lower bound for a non-negative lockout time.

lockout-time-invalid-test.reason: A negative literal lockout time violates the non-negative source constraint.

listening-protocol-safe-test.reason: Collected transport protocol tcp uses the required lower-case form.

listening-protocol-invalid-test.reason: Upper-case TCP is not the canonical lower-case collected protocol form.

registry-key-null-safe-test.reason: A null key selects the hive itself and therefore requires a null value name.

registry-key-null-invalid-test.reason: A non-null value name cannot be evaluated when the containing registry key is null.

registry-value-type-safe-test.reason: A dword registry type and integer value predicate use compatible native datatypes.

registry-value-type-invalid-test.reason: A dword registry type cannot be compared as a string when both type and value datatype are asserted.

text-pattern-operation-safe-test.reason: The text-file Object pattern uses the canonical match operation.

text-pattern-operation-invalid-test.reason: An equality selector is not the required pattern operation for text-file collection.

xml-xpath-operation-safe-test.reason: The XML Object XPath selector is an equality predicate for an XPath 1.0 expression.

xml-xpath-operation-invalid-test.reason: Pattern matching is not the canonical equality selector for an XML XPath.

yaml-content-operation-safe-test.reason: Inline YAML content selection uses equality semantics.

yaml-content-operation-invalid-test.reason: Inline YAML content is a complete value and cannot use a pattern selector.

plist-path-operation-safe-test.reason: The plist filepath Object selector uses equality semantics.

plist-path-operation-invalid-test.reason: A pattern selector is not the canonical equality operation for plist filepath.

panos-xpath-operation-safe-test.reason: PAN-OS XPath selection uses equality semantics.

panos-xpath-operation-invalid-test.reason: A pattern selector is not the canonical equality operation for PAN-OS XPath.

pwpolicy-auth-pair-safe-test.reason: Omitting both optional authenticator members preserves the unauthenticated policy form.

pwpolicy-auth-pair-invalid-test.reason: An authenticator password without its paired authenticator violates the native pair constraint.

pwpolicy-password-equal-safe-test.reason: The authenticator password selector uses equality semantics.

pwpolicy-password-equal-invalid-test.reason: A pattern operation is not the native equality operation for authenticator_password.

pwpolicy-directory-equal-safe-test.reason: The directory_node selector uses equality semantics.

pwpolicy-directory-equal-invalid-test.reason: A pattern operation is not the native equality operation for directory_node.

pwpolicy-xpath-equal-safe-test.reason: The policy XPath selector uses equality semantics.

pwpolicy-xpath-equal-invalid-test.reason: A pattern operation is not the native equality operation for policy XPath.

cmdlet-module-guid-safe-test.reason: The literal module_id is a canonical Windows GUID.

cmdlet-module-guid-invalid-test.reason: A non-null literal module_id that is not a GUID is a semantic error.

dpkg-debian-evr-safe-test.reason: A Debian package EVR is compared with the preferred debian_evr datatype.

sid-defaults-safe-test.reason: The direct SID Object materializes both group behavior parameters.

sid-defaults-invalid-test.reason: A direct SID Object omitting imported group behavior defaults is semantically incomplete.

sid-sid-defaults-safe-test.reason: The SID-targeted Object materializes both group behavior parameters.

sid-sid-defaults-invalid-test.reason: A direct SID-targeted Object omitting imported group behavior defaults is semantically incomplete.

ntuser-value-type-safe-test.reason: A registry dword type and integer NT-user value predicate use compatible datatypes.

ntuser-value-type-invalid-test.reason: A registry dword type cannot be compared as a string when both type and value datatype are asserted.

password-range-safe-test.reason: Zero is the inclusive lower bound for a non-negative password-policy age.

password-range-invalid-test.reason: A negative literal password-policy age violates the source range constraint.

plist-xpath-operation-safe-test.reason: The plist XPath selector uses equality semantics.

plist-xpath-operation-invalid-test.reason: A pattern selector is not the canonical equality operation for plist XPath.

systemprofiler-xpath-operation-safe-test.reason: The system_profiler XPath selector uses equality semantics.

systemprofiler-xpath-operation-invalid-t.reason: A pattern selector is not the canonical equality operation for system_profiler XPath.

shadow-encrypt-safe-test.reason: SHA-512 is an admitted OVAL encryption-method literal.

shadow-encrypt-invalid-test.reason: An empty encryption method is reserved for variable serialization and is not a native literal.

yaml-yamlpath-safe-test.reason: The YAMLPath selector uses equality semantics.

yaml-yamlpath-invalid-test.reason: A pattern selector is not the canonical equality operation for YAMLPath.

yaml-full-path-traversal-test.reason: Traversal is rejected when YAML content selects full_path.

shadow-encrypt-boundary-test.reason: DES is the lower lexical boundary of the admitted encryption-method vocabulary.

xml-item-creation-safe-test.reason: The XML Object explicitly materializes the imported all-object-elements item-creation default.

xml-item-creation-invalid-test.reason: A direct XML Object omitting the materialized item-creation behavior is semantically incomplete.

rpm-package-defaults-safe-test.reason: The RPM package Object explicitly materializes both verification switches.

rpm-package-defaults-invalid-test.reason: A direct RPM package Object omitting imported verification switches is semantically incomplete.

rpm-file-defaults-safe-test.reason: The RPM file Object explicitly materializes every non-deprecated verification switch.

rpm-file-defaults-invalid-test.reason: A direct RPM file Object omitting imported verification switches is semantically incomplete.

file-rights-literal-safe-test.reason: Reserved characters are permitted inside a filename match expression.

file-rights-literal-invalid-test.reason: A literal Windows filename cannot contain reserved characters.

file-rights-trustee-sid-safe-test.reason: File effective-rights identifies the trustee by SID.

ios-version-typed-safe-test.reason: IOS version fields preserve the source lexical version string and the distinct integer/string component datatypes.

yaml-record-keys-safe-test.reason: Native YAML record field identity preserves the authored key spelling.

wmi-structured-result-safe-test.reason: WMI query results remain structured records whose selected field identity is observable.

cmdlet-structured-record-safe-test.reason: PowerShell cmdlet parameters, selected fields, and values retain structured record semantics.

userright-case-safe-test.reason: Trustee names use an explicit case-insensitive comparison as recommended by the Windows identity rule.

wu-defaults-safe-test.reason: The direct Object explicitly materializes include_superseded_updates.

wu-defaults-invalid-test.reason: A direct Object omitting the required materialized superseded-update default is semantically incomplete.

ntuser-defaults-safe-test.reason: The direct NT-user Object explicitly carries both imported collection defaults.

ntuser-defaults-invalid-test.reason: An NT-user Object omitting materialized include_default and item_creation is semantically incomplete.
